lessons.title: Plan with a known finite model
Replace a table with a differentiable function
Shape rewards without changing the objective
Learn a policy from sampled returns
Reduce variance with a value baseline

readings.title: Agents, environments and episodes
readings.goal: Trace a toy delivery agent through a complete episode; distinguish agent, environment and policy without notation.

readings.title: One step: actions, observations and rewards
readings.goal: Record a delivery transition and explain each field, including the next observation and reward units.

readings.title: Resetting and ending an episode
readings.goal: Trace success versus a time limit using reset and the five step outputs; distinguish termination, truncation and collector cutoff before targets appear.

readings.title: Spaces and the environment contract
readings.goal: Describe valid chain actions and observations, check array formats and seeds, and verify the environment interface.

readings.title: State versus observation
readings.goal: Compare two identical observations with different hidden battery charge; distinguish simulator state from what the agent sees.

readings.title: When the present is enough
readings.goal: Calculate different next-step outcomes for the hidden-charge example and explain why omitted information matters.

readings.title: A model of decisions and outcomes
readings.goal: Introduce the MDP tuple one symbol at a time using a delivery transition table; defer calculating expectations to the probability lesson.

readings.title: Working with incomplete observations
readings.goal: Compare adding a sensor, using observation history and a belief-state idea; explain why an encoder cannot invent missing information.

readings.title: Reward versus accumulated return
readings.goal: Sum three delivery rewards; discuss the reward hypothesis as a modeling assumption and show a proxy objective that fails.

readings.title: Discounting step by step
readings.goal: Calculate a three-step discounted return and distinguish a discount factor from a learning rate.

readings.title: Finite and continuing horizons
readings.goal: Compare a finite undiscounted task with a continuing discounted task; state bounded-reward assumptions and time-in-state requirements.

readings.title: Computing returns and their units
readings.goal: Implement reverse return accumulation; distinguish realized return from expected return and trace reward centering on fixed versus variable horizons.

readings.title: Probabilities over possible outcomes
readings.goal: Normalize a two-outcome table and calculate joint probabilities under an explicit independence assumption.

readings.title: An average weighted by probability
readings.goal: Calculate expected reward and expected continuation separately; compare sample averages with exact model averages and rare outcomes.

readings.title: Policies and legal actions
readings.goal: Specify deterministic and stochastic policies; calculate legal-action probabilities and tie handling with an action mask.

readings.title: State values and action values
readings.goal: Compare two delivery actions using their expected returns; define V and Q only after the examples.

readings.title: One Bellman backup
readings.goal: Derive the return decomposition and calculate a backup with reward and two successor values; explain terminal continuation and finite gamma=1.

readings.title: Expectation versus maximization
readings.goal: Compute policy evaluation and greedy improvement from the same table; separate expectation over outcomes from maximization over legal actions.

readings.title: Evaluation and optimality
readings.goal: Compare a policy Bellman equation with an optimality equation; recap masking and time-dependent finite-horizon values.

readings.title: Why repeated backups can converge
readings.goal: Work a discounted contraction example and distinguish its assumptions from finite-horizon backward induction.

readings.title: Building the F1 environment contract
readings.goal: Map the 16-feature observation, six actions, masks, seeding and ending flags to the toy contract; retain the complete step trace.

readings.title: Composing one race transition
readings.goal: Trace compound pace/life, capped wear cliff, fuel, weather, pit-lap ordering and fresh safety-car sampling through pure shared dynamics.

readings.title: Reward units and the race objective
readings.goal: Prove negative lap-time accumulation and fixed-horizon centering numerically; state variable-length caveats and avoid describing a plan as executed evidence.

readings.title: Wrapping and verifying shared dynamics
readings.goal: Explain the stateful Gymnasium wrapper, pure dynamics, environment tests and readiness checkpoint; introduce dashboard and rule-based baseline handoffs.

readings.title: Planning versus learning
readings.goal: Compare access to a transition model with access to sampled transitions using the same tiny task.

readings.title: A known finite model
readings.goal: Enumerate time-indexed states and legal actions, assign terminal values and count states before solving.

readings.title: Backward induction by hand
readings.goal: Preserve the worked pit-now versus stay-out example and show why greedy one-step decisions fail.

readings.title: Implement and independently verify a solver
readings.goal: Compare a tiny backward solver with brute-force action sequences; include terminal and no-legal-action cases.

readings.title: Backward induction and value iteration
readings.goal: Work a discounted iterative example and contrast stopping rules with an acyclic finite horizon.

readings.title: Recap probability and expectation
readings.goal: Recompute a hazard/no-event weighted average and state conditional independence before combining hazards and weather.

readings.title: Weighted outcome backups
readings.goal: Calculate a complete stochastic Bellman cell; keep successor-dependent costs inside the correct expectation.

readings.title: Rare outcomes and risk
readings.goal: Compare average cost with a rare costly outcome; distinguish risk-neutral optimization from a changed risk objective.

readings.title: A complete stochastic planning example
readings.goal: Extend the independently checked solver with safety-car hazard, legal masks and a second random process; validate probability sums.

readings.title: Transition matrices and chains
readings.goal: Count and normalize the existing three-race 3-by-3 weather example; discuss unobserved rows rather than dividing by zero.

readings.title: Sampling is not knowing the future
readings.goal: Trace seeded sampling from a fitted chain and distinguish a sampled rollout from privileged future information.

readings.title: Variation between rollouts
readings.goal: Compare multiple traces and distributions of returns; distinguish deterministic calculations from stochastic evaluation.

readings.title: Checking transitions against the model
readings.goal: Compare empirical transition frequencies with the specified matrix using sample counts and uncertainty.

readings.title: Modeling the F1 planning state
readings.goal: Preserve DP state-size arithmetic, hazard/weather assumptions, masks and the noise=0 expectation argument with its limitations.

readings.title: An achievable oracle and a foresight bound
readings.goal: Distinguish Oracle A and B, cost versus reward signs, a real-scale backward cell and the optimality-gap metric.

readings.title: Shared dynamics and independent oracle checks
readings.goal: Map solver/weather modules and rollout harness to brute force, probability and consistency checks; explain checkpoint evidence.

readings.title: Learning from transitions
readings.goal: Replace an exact expectation with a sampled transition; explain bootstrapping as estimating from an estimate.

readings.title: Target, error and update
readings.goal: Calculate target, TD error and learning-rate update separately on a three-state toy.

readings.title: Q-learning step by step
readings.goal: Preserve four hand-run updates, distinguish learning rate and discount, and state finite-table convergence conditions without promising a practical guarantee.

readings.title: Terminal targets and legal actions
readings.goal: Contrast termination, time-limit bootstrap and cutoff; calculate a masked maximum and handle terminal rows with no legal successor.

readings.title: Why greedy discovery fails
readings.goal: Show a never-visited rewarding action under greedy-only selection.

readings.title: Epsilon-greedy probabilities
readings.goal: Derive probabilities including the exploratory share on greedy actions, ties and legal-action masks.

readings.title: Behavior and evaluation policies
readings.goal: Compare exploratory training with greedy evaluation using separate random streams and recorded evidence.

readings.title: Ties, masks and exploration schedules
readings.goal: Calculate the existing linear-decay example; enforce masks inside random sampling and explain reproducibility limits.

readings.title: Which policy supplies the target?
readings.goal: Compare Q-learning's maximum with the action actually sampled by a behavior policy.

readings.title: Sampled SARSA
readings.goal: Trace the risky-push versus safe-pit example and pre-commit the next action before changing Q.

readings.title: Expected targets
readings.goal: Calculate Expected SARSA with epsilon-greedy probabilities and distinguish it from sampled SARSA and Q-learning.

readings.title: A fair small comparison
readings.goal: Align seeds, masks, reward units and evaluation policies; preserve the shared learner-shell exercise and detect target leakage.

readings.title: Representing observations in a table
readings.goal: Calculate the existing Cartesian state count and explain table growth versus generalization.

readings.title: Interval boundaries
readings.goal: Work boundary, overflow and underflow cases; state the convention for digitize/searchsorted explicitly.

readings.title: Aliasing training cannot fix
readings.goal: Preserve the tyre-cliff bin collision and show two states sharing a code but requiring different actions.

readings.title: Choosing and testing an encoder
readings.goal: Test feature order, edges and distinct strategically important states; distinguish quantization from missing physical state.

readings.title: Mapping observations and masks to the Q-table
readings.goal: Retain dimension-by-dimension discretization, reward-scale arithmetic, recorded bin/action-mask bugs and their tests.

readings.title: Training, curriculum and evaluation
readings.goal: Explain curriculum switches, SARSA pre-commit mechanics, evaluation cadence and optimality gaps; map readiness to unchanged practice evidence.

readings.title: Tables versus functions
readings.goal: Preserve dimensionality arithmetic and show one shared function predicting values for nearby observations.

readings.title: Vectors and tensor shapes
readings.goal: Explain scalar/vector/matrix and batch dimensions with a two-observation, three-action example before matrix multiplication.

readings.title: Forward pass and loss
readings.goal: Preserve the tiny-network forward pass, selected-action gather, squared loss and batch reduction with explicit shapes.

readings.title: Derivatives and backpropagation
readings.goal: Calculate a scalar derivative and apply the chain rule to the same tiny network; distinguish gradient direction from loss value.

readings.title: One optimizer update
readings.goal: Trace zero_grad, backward and step; introduce SGD and Adam's role, finite checks and the delivered tensor exercise.

readings.title: How Adam rescales a gradient
readings.goal: Calculate a first/second moment update and bias correction; explain that the core optimizer usage needs no hidden derivation.

readings.title: Why neural TD targets move
readings.goal: Trace a bootstrap target changing as online weights change; explain correlated samples and feedback.

readings.title: Target networks and detachment
readings.goal: Distinguish independent snapshot storage, no-grad target calculation and hard/soft updates with the existing update-rate arithmetic.

readings.title: Replay decorrelation and reuse
readings.goal: Build a minimal buffer; explain capacity, sampling, warm-up and reuse without implying samples become independent automatically.

readings.title: A complete DQN update
readings.goal: Trace gather, masks, ending flags, detached targets, loss and optimizer shapes; separate training steps from target-sync timing.

readings.title: Maximization bias
readings.goal: Compare noisy action estimates and demonstrate why selecting their maximum can exaggerate value.

readings.title: Double DQN selection and evaluation
readings.goal: Preserve online [5,4,100], target [1,7,99], legal mask and 1.5 versus 4.5 targets; avoid a universal performance claim.

readings.title: Dueling value and advantage
readings.goal: Build two heads on a shared trunk and compare their roles using a small action-value vector.

readings.title: Identifiability and centering
readings.goal: Derive constant-offset ambiguity and mean centering; preserve the delivered centering convention and distinguish it from policy advantages.

readings.title: Legal-action handling
readings.goal: Trace illegal actions, ties and terminal empty masks through selection and evaluation; state where dueling centering and legal selection differ.

readings.title: Why prioritize samples?
readings.goal: Compare TD errors and explain stale priorities, epsilon and possible overuse of noisy transitions.

readings.title: Raw priority versus probability
readings.goal: Normalize powered raw priorities on a tiny buffer and verify the sum; distinguish priority from sampling probability.

readings.title: Importance weights
readings.goal: Calculate inverse-probability weights and beta/normalization, including the zero-priority safeguard.

readings.title: Updating and checking priorities
readings.goal: Trace sampling, weighted loss and detached error feedback; test empirical frequencies and preserve the pack's conventions.

readings.title: Reward scale, loss and gradients
readings.goal: Preserve the numerical scale trap and centering assumptions; explain effects on targets, TD errors and priorities without promising invariance in neural optimization.

readings.title: Integrating a DQN learner
readings.goal: Map observation dimensions, architecture, replay, schedules and all extension flags to one complete update and unchanged packs.

readings.title: Reading DQN checks and ablation evidence
readings.goal: Separate recorded PyTorch fixtures from live training; audit walkthrough and target/mask/shape checks before the project checkpoint.

readings.title: Joint actions and rewards
readings.goal: Trace a two-agent transition and identify shared state, observations, actions and individual or team reward.

readings.title: Team reward versus contribution
readings.goal: Compare equal team rewards with different individual actions; explain credit assignment without assuming causal attribution.

readings.title: Credit assignment examples
readings.goal: Preserve lap-time, position and dense-proxy comparisons; show a proxy rewarding behavior that hurts the objective.

readings.title: Limits and useful diagnostics
readings.goal: Compare three reward designs with fixed scenarios and counterfactual diagnostics; distinguish attribution from correlation.

readings.title: Base objectives and reward bonuses
readings.goal: Work an ad-hoc position-bonus counterexample before introducing a principled alternative.

readings.title: Potential differences
readings.goal: Calculate gamma times next potential minus current potential and distinguish it from an arbitrary bonus.

readings.title: Telescoping returns and terminal treatment
readings.goal: Expand a finite return term by term; account for terminal potential, gamma and variable horizons.

readings.title: Conditions and counterexamples
readings.goal: State policy-invariance assumptions; preserve a non-telescoping implementation failure and terminal-potential counterexample.

readings.title: Interaction mechanics
readings.goal: Use a generic blocking/overtaking toy to show when relative position actually affects future actions.

readings.title: Opponents as part of transitions
readings.goal: Compare a fixed scripted rival with an adaptive rival; distinguish joint model from a single-agent effective model.

readings.title: Missing state versus a changing policy
readings.goal: Contrast aliasing with nonstationarity using two identical observations and changed opponent behavior.

readings.title: Nonstationarity and evaluation design
readings.goal: Evaluate against fixed, named opponents; separate mechanical model defects from inadequate training.

readings.title: Position, overtaking and dirty air
readings.goal: Retain 19-dimensional observations, fixed rivals, undercut/blocking mechanism and probabilistic overtake ordering.

readings.title: Tracing interaction defects
readings.goal: Trace E1 double-counting, E2 overwritten overtakes, E3 dynamics/reward inconsistency, E5 shaping and E6 smaller findings with their consequences.

readings.title: Reward comparisons and reachable objectives
readings.goal: Map the staged blocking toy, three reward configurations and tests to checkpoint checks; state what passing tests cannot establish.

readings.title: Best response to whom?
readings.goal: Compare policies against two fixed opponents and explain why a single optimal response can be fragile.

readings.title: Payoff matrices
readings.goal: Preserve the complete rock-paper-scissors witness and calculate payoffs against an opponent mixture.

readings.title: Mixed strategies and equilibrium
readings.goal: Calculate a best response to a mixture and illustrate equilibrium without promising convergence of independent neural learners.

readings.title: Robustness beyond one opponent
readings.goal: Compare independent learning, centralized training and empirical fictitious play; distinguish snapshot mixtures from exact strategy averages.

readings.title: Forgetting historical opponents
readings.goal: Trace a cyclic best-response sequence and why newest-only evaluation misses forgetting.

readings.title: Independent snapshots
readings.goal: Compare copying parameters with sharing mutable storage; define evaluation mode and fixed snapshots.

readings.title: Sampling an opponent pool
readings.goal: Calculate normalized uniform/recency-biased probabilities and preserve the first-opponent degenerate-seed failure.

readings.title: Coverage and evaluation over time
readings.goal: Evaluate historical opponents, pool size and replacement; separate coverage metrics from a convergence claim.

readings.title: Fair pairings and baselines
readings.goal: Align starting conditions, roles and seeds; preserve the shuffled-pairing null baseline for apparent bimodality.

readings.title: Stochasticity and uncertainty
readings.goal: Compare sample counts, variability and uncertainty; distinguish an observed two-peak histogram from evidence of specialization.

readings.title: Multi-agent lifecycle
readings.goal: Trace generic AEC and Parallel APIs, selected-agent cleanup, per-agent ending dictionaries and live/dead agent sets.

readings.title: A defensible comparison
readings.goal: Specify opponents, transitions, pairings, held-out scenarios and recorded-versus-live evidence before interpreting results.

readings.title: Blocking and opponent initialization
readings.goal: Preserve the Phase 6 blocking dependency, first-opponent problem and the staged toy intervention demonstrating consequences.

readings.title: The F1 multi-agent interface and pool
readings.goal: Map Parallel environment, independent learner loop and pool parameters to validated lifecycle/snapshot contracts.

readings.title: Historical evaluation and evidence
readings.goal: Map bimodality null tests and readiness items to the plan; explain which claims the listed tests do and do not support.

readings.title: Policy probabilities and logs
readings.goal: Normalize logits with softmax, explain logarithms using likelihood products and calculate log probability of a sampled action.

readings.title: Gradients of log probabilities
readings.goal: Derive a small softmax score vector and show that probability-weighted scores sum to zero; introduce trajectory likelihood assumptions.

readings.title: Gradient intuition
readings.goal: Compare increasing a rewarded action's probability with directly differentiating the reward; explain ascent versus loss minimization.

readings.title: The score-function derivation
readings.goal: Derive the likelihood-ratio identity and episodic return-to-go under stated differentiability/support assumptions.

readings.title: REINFORCE by hand
readings.goal: Preserve the worked softmax gradient and noisy-bandit update with probabilities, return and gradient signs.

readings.title: Implement and diagnose a sampled update
readings.goal: Trace log_prob times detached return, batch reduction and optimizer; show variance and destructive steps in the delivered exercise.

readings.title: Value baselines
readings.goal: Compare raw returns with the worked value-baseline example and explain the baseline's prediction target.

readings.title: Why action-independent baselines work
readings.goal: Sum baseline-weighted score gradients over actions and identify action independence and detached actor weights.

readings.title: Advantages and actor–critic
readings.goal: Calculate Q minus V and a one-step estimated advantage; distinguish exact advantages from sampled estimates.

readings.title: Keeping actor and critic gradients separate
readings.goal: Trace actor loss and critic loss on one batch; detach advantage and explain shared-trunk versus accidental target gradients.

readings.title: TD residuals as advantage signals
readings.goal: Calculate two residuals using rewards, values and ending flags; distinguish critic error from an advantage estimator.

readings.title: The lambda-weighted sum
readings.goal: Preserve the hand-worked GAE example, lambda extremes and bias/variance assumptions.

readings.title: Reverse recursion
readings.goal: Implement and manually verify the reverse recurrence on the same residuals and explicit batch/time shapes.

readings.title: Terminals, time limits and rollout cutoffs
readings.goal: Separate bootstrap eligibility from recursion continuation; bootstrap the final observation at truncation without leaking into a reset episode.

readings.title: Old versus current policy
readings.goal: Freeze rollout log probabilities and distinguish current-policy updates from resampling old likelihoods.

readings.title: Likelihood ratios
readings.goal: Calculate exp(new_log_prob minus old_log_prob), masked distributions and support requirements.

readings.title: Both clipping branches
readings.goal: Work positive and negative advantages inside and outside the clipping interval; calculate min and gradient incentive.

readings.title: What the surrogate limits
readings.goal: Show an out-of-range ratio and explain why clipping is no hard trust-region or universal stability guarantee.

readings.title: Minibatches and implementation checks
readings.goal: Trace frozen old data across epochs, detached advantages, critic updates and diagnostics; align with the delivered PPO exercise.

readings.title: Building and using a PPO implementation
readings.goal: Preserve build-versus-buy reasoning and inventory library behavior that must be understood despite using a packaged learner.

readings.title: Vector environments and masked PPO
readings.goal: Explain SB3/MaskablePPO learn/predict, rollout arithmetic, logging, evaluation masks and train/eval mode contracts; verify APIs during authoring.

readings.title: Factories, serialization and worker contracts
readings.goal: Distinguish ordinary pickle from SB3 mechanisms; preserve the local spawn exercise, main guard, serializable factories and worker-local masks.

readings.title: Fair algorithm comparison
readings.goal: Preserve both fixes to the unequal-transition budget, worker-count arithmetic and curriculum compounding; align experience and evaluation protocols.

readings.title: F1 PPO integration and verification
readings.goal: Map wrapper, agent, configuration, recorded integration evidence and test limitations to readiness without assuming self-play was studied.
